terbaru.judul: Evolving Collective Behavior in Self-Organizing Particle Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we present EvoSOPS, an evolutionary framework that searches landscapes of stochastic distributed algorithms for those that achieve a mathematically specified target behavior.

terbaru.judul: Latent Neural Cellular Automata for Resource-Efficient Image Restoration
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we introduce the Latent Neural Cellular Automata (LNCA) model, a novel architecture designed to address the resource limitations of neural cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: Looking for Complexity at Phase Boundaries in Continuous Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: Focusing on the case of continuous systems, we introduce the 'Phase Transition Finder'(PTF) algorithm, which can be used to efficiently generate parameters lying at the border between two phases.

terbaru.judul: Discovering Sensorimotor Agency in Cellular Automata using Diversity Search
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that this approach enables to find systematically environmental conditions in CA leading to self-organization of such basic forms of agency.

terbaru.judul: Quality Diversity in the Amorphous Fortress (QD-AF): Evolving for Complexity in 0-Player Games
terbaru.pelajaran: Our approach, Quality Diversity in Amorphous Fortress (QD-AF) generates families of 0-player games akin to simplistic ecological models, and we identify the emergence of both competitive and co-operative multi-agent and multi-species survival dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Emergence and criticality in spatiotemporal synchronization: the complementarity model
terbaru.pelajaran: This work concerns the long-term dynamics of a spatiotemporal many-body deterministic model that exhibits emergence and self-organization, and which has been recently proposed as a new paradigm for Artificial Life.

terbaru.judul: The emergence of dynamic networks from many coupled polar oscillators. A model for Artificial Life
terbaru.pelajaran: This work concerns a many-body deterministic model that displays life-like properties as emergence, complexity, self-organization, spontaneous compartmentalization, and self-regulation.

terbaru.judul: Amorphous Fortress: Observing Emergent Behavior in Multi-Agent FSMs
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a system called Amorphous Fortress -- an abstract, yet spatial, open-ended artificial life simulation.

terbaru.judul: The Effect of Noise on the Emergence of Continuous Norms and its Evolutionary Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We examine the effect of noise on societies of agents using an agent-based model of evolutionary norm emergence.

terbaru.judul: On the Existence of Information Bottlenecks in Living and Non-Living Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: In many complex systems, we observe that `interesting behaviour' is often the consequence of a system exploiting the existence of an Information Bottleneck (IB).
